reasoning: Users storing medical data (prescriptions) need to feel a sense of calm, stability, and privacy. A dark 'tech' theme feels too cold and potentially insecure. An earthy, tactile light theme with bone-white and deep moss green grounds the experience, making the digital vault feel as reliable as a physical file cabinet.

headings.usage: Use tight tracking (tracking-tight) for large sizes. Max text-4xl for main headers.

body.usage: Use for all data display, expiration dates, and UI labels. Highly legible.

rules.overline: Uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs for labels like 'EXPIRATION DATE', 'WARRANTY PHOTO'
rules.hierarchy: H1 max text-4xl, H2 text-2xl. Don't oversize.

page_specific_rules.dashboard: Display family profiles as horizontal scrolling bento cards or a clean vertical list. Each profile must immediately show if a prescription is ACTIVE (green dot) or EXPIRED (red dot).
page_specific_rules.person_profile: Minimalist header with name and avatar. Below: The main 'Current Prescription' card. Use a strong visual separation between the Prescription (Vault) and the Shopping links (Internet).
page_specific_rules.prescription_replace_flow: CRITICAL: Do not show 'History'. When tapping the prescription photo, open a full-screen or large modal to view it. To update, provide a 'Replace Prescription' button. Show a clear warning: 'This will overwrite your current prescription photo.'
page_specific_rules.reminders: Use Shadcn Tabs or simple toggles for Contact Lens tracking (Daily/Bi-weekly/Monthly). Keep it strictly local.
page_specific_rules.privacy_screen: Use a clear, typographic explainer. Left-aligned, tight tracking headers. Split into two columns or clear lists: 'Stored on Device (Secure)' vs 'Uses Internet (GPS/Shopping)'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #1C2A24 text against #F9F6F0 meets 4.5:1 ratio. Ensure #4A6B5D buttons have white text.
accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements MUST have role-based kebab-case data-testid. Examples: data-testid='profile-card-john', data-testid='replace-prescription-button', data-testid='expiration-date-input', data-testid='add-profile-button', data-testid='save-prescription-confirm-button'.

privacy_hero.description: Family portrait for marketing or onboarding

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do not invent gradients.
The UI is a Medical/Privacy Vault. Elements should feel 'tactile' (subtle borders, large tap areas) and non-clinical.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use Outfit (Headings) and IBM Plex Sans (Body).
Adhere strictly to the 'Replace-Only' flow. Never implement a history array for prescriptions.
Ensure 'Current Prescription' card is heavily prioritized visually over GPS/Shopping buttons.
Ensure all buttons, tabs, and form elements include data-testid properties.
Use pure Tailwind CSS for layout logic and heavily custom Shadcn for modals/dialogs/forms.
